نضطلع (form VIII)
# نَضْطَلِعُ (naḍṭaliʕu) /nadˤ.tˤa.li.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# نَضْطَلِعَ (naḍṭaliʕa) /nadˤ.tˤa.li.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# نَضْطَلِعْ (naḍṭaliʕ) /nadˤ.tˤa.liʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
